lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 113, Lines 9 and 13 (household employment taxes; uncollected social security and Medicare tax on W-2 box 12 codes A, B, M, N). As in the landing round: the reply's screen for Schedule 2 amounts the tool does not figure leaves out s2.household_employee and s2.w2_marks (both in its input list), so the line other forms rely on (s8812 line 22, s1a, tipjob) would not refuse a Schedule H or uncollected-tax return. It also reads s2.mortgage_subsidy and s2.lookback raw (the project asks them only of a home owner and of a Schedule C filer). Triage (pass fbc614250ee5): 2,669/2,922 agree; no value in the bank; completed: 35 candidate-unknown (s2.mortgage_subsidy not asked); 218 candidate-/project-unknown on incomplete or refused records.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 111, Line 1a: "If the advance credit payments were more than the premium tax credit you can claim, the amount you must repay will be shown on Form 8962, line 29. Enter that amount, if any, on line 1a"; i8962 p. 3, Who Must File (Form 8962 only with a Form 1095-A or advance payments). The project enters zero when no Form 1095-A is listed; the candidate copies Form 8962 line 29 on every return, so a filer with no Marketplace coverage must answer Form 8962's questions (f8962.alloc) and reach its household income. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`../triage/s2.json`; 1,372 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 80 partial records; 1,952 comparisons): 603 of 1,952 agree; 889 candidate-unknown (489 on completed returns, for example witnesses 0-5 classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek, project $0.00); 460 candidate-refuses, all on refused returns (witnesses 6-11, for example classm.w2.1.deepseek, classm.f8889.2.deepseek: refusals reached through Form 8962's household income); no value differs. The published interface offers the f1095a count, so the guard was expressible. Same ruling as Stage 18 and round 1. Project stands.

Ruling: scope; the project refuses alternative minimum tax through the computed screen s2.amt (Form 6251 refusal on line 2; this round adds the Schedule 1 line 8a net operating loss deduction, Form 6251 line 2e, to its line 4 estimate, s2.amt_l4_sum) and enters zero otherwise; the reply figures Form 6251 itself with its own refusals. Triage (pass 4d367142f549) 2,550/3,238 agree with no value difference anywhere: on completed returns 208 candidate-unknown (the reply reads Form 6251 inputs the interview does not ask, e.g. s2.amt_boat) and 2 candidate-refuses; the rest are on refused or incomplete records (171 project-refuses at s2.amt). f1040s2 line 2; i6251 Who Must File. As in the Goal-1 round.
